items.quote: I wanted to mount my TV, found Done By Dwayne. He was on time and equipped to handle the job and removed obstacles to complete the task. He even provided an HDMI cord as the one I had was too short. 10/10. Will use again and highly recommend

Dwayne has done so many projects for me. From installing new plumbing fixtures, new lighting fixtures, grout repair and a new sweep for my front door. He is professional, courteous, friendly and very knowledgeable. I highly recommend Dwayne

I hired Dwayne for several repairs, and I couldn't be more impressed. He was punctual, professional, and skilled, fixing a leaky faucet, repairing drywall, and installing light fixtures with great attention to detail. His rates were fair.
